quests.title: Cleanup At Dawn

dialogue.t: Clean the place again, and I want it spotless this time! This is about making a good first impression!
Sorry, Ms. Adelinde!
We'll be more careful this time, Ms. Adelinde!
Ah, hello, Traveler. Welcome to the Dawn Winery. The storm may have passed, but here at the Winery we're still cleaning up the mess it made.
I'm trying to organize the cleanup operation, but these girls, they—
Sorry, Ms. Adelinde!
We'll be more careful this time, Ms. Adelinde!
Yes, you've said that already, thank you very much! Now, why don't you put your efforts into cleaning instead of standing here apologizing to me? Shoo!
These kids... Ugh, they're so sloppy. I don't know how we'll ever get through it all at their rate of progress. And even after that, there's still the indoors that needs cleaning.
Do you know how to sweep? Actually, scrap that, we're so short-staffed that I should be taking all the help I can get.
Follow me indoors, there's plenty of cleaning that needs doing in there, too.
Really? That's wonderful. Well, since you're willing, I'll gladly take you up on the offer.
Follow me indoors, there's plenty of cleaning that needs doing in there, too.
Ugh, the Winery is just too big. How are we supposed to clean the whole place?
After cleaning the outside, there's still the inside to do. Are we ever gonna get this place clean...
Ugh, the Winery is just too big. How are we supposed to clean the whole place?
After cleaning the outside, there's still the inside to do. Are we ever gonna get this place clean...
It's so wonderful that you are able to help out. I know I have Moco and Hillie, but... *sigh* they're more a hindrance, to be honest...
Finished?
Wonderful, this was a huge help. I can't imagine how long this would have taken me by myself.
And if I'd gotten the girls to do it... Who knows how many items they'd end up destroying in the process...
Thank you, please take these. I do apologize for troubling you, a visitor, with the work of a Winery maid.
Next time you visit, the Winery will be spotless.

quests.description: After the storm, head housemaid Adelinde is preparing to render the Dawn Winery spick and span on the inside and out, but things aren’t going so smoothly…
